hypothesis.en: Two independent language-model judges plus a small owner audit can measure meaning more faithfully than literal phrase matching.
hypothesis.ru: Две независимые LLM-судьи и небольшая проверка владельца могут оценить смысл честнее, чем буквальный поиск фраз.

why.en: A larger multilingual instruction model from a family different from the tested Qwen.
why.ru: Большая многоязычная instruction-модель из другой семьи, чем проверяемая Qwen.

why.en: A separate multilingual model family used to expose disagreements, not to overrule the larger judge.
why.ru: Другая многоязычная семья моделей: она нужна, чтобы находить разногласия, а не автоматически отменять решение большой модели.

hidden_from_judges: model name that produced the answer
other answers to the same question

rubric.rule: Judge meaning, including paraphrases. Do not infer a missing cause from the question.
Judge meaning, including paraphrases. A conflicting or unsafe instruction is incorrect.
True when any part of the answer conflicts with the expected cause or safe action.
Correct requires both parts and no contradiction. Partial preserves exactly one part or is genuinely unclear. Otherwise incorrect.

evidence_rule.cause_quote: An exact quote copied from the answer, or null when absent.
evidence_rule.safe_action_quote: An exact quote copied from the answer, or null when absent.
evidence_rule.validation: The runner rejects and retries any non-null quote that is not an exact substring of the answer.

cases_include: correct words followed by a contradiction
calibration.rule: A judge must pass 12 of 12 deterministic calibration cases before it may see experiment answers. A failure stops the run; no prompt tuning on experiment answers is allowed.

owner_audit.sampling: two deterministic records from each condition-language cell
owner_audit.expansion_rule: If the owner corrects more than 2 of the 24 agreements, all remaining agreements require human review.
owner_audit.final_authority: The owner's label overrides both judges and is preserved beside their original decisions.

gate_recalculation.note: The thresholds do not change. Only the meaning of correctness is repaired.

claim_boundary.en: Agreement between two judges is not truth. Gate 5B.2 will report judge agreement, owner corrections, and unresolved uncertainty beside the semantic scores.
claim_boundary.ru: Согласие двух судей — ещё не истина. Gate 5B.2 покажет согласие судей, исправления владельца и оставшуюся неопределённость рядом со смысловыми баллами.
